title: Consolidated execution — fill gaps, measure cost, confirm/reject the candidate
phases_gated: P4 preregistered confirmation on NEW assets (G4)

primary_target.desc: +1 ATR before -1 ATR within 6 bars, RR=1.0

candidate_rule: single preregistered hypothesis; replaced ONLY if a GATE_VOL combo strictly dominates it in TRAIN under CPCV out-of-sample e010

gate_vol_definition.vol_t: stdev of log returns over 20 CLOSED 4H bars, strictly before the signal bar (causal)
gate_vol_definition.quartile_source: TRAIN only, pooled across symbols, FROZEN
forbidden: any regime label using look-ahead observations

multiple_testing.effective_n_trials: Li-Ji from correlation of the 36 combos

execution_cost.spread: liquidity-tiered declared (CS reported as upper bound)

p4_confirmation.method: Option A — cross-sectional OOS on assets NEVER used in L0072-L0080, same window 2024-09-04..2026-08-30, frozen definitions verbatim
p4_confirmation.fallback: Option B (candidate on 1H) if fetch fails

success_criteria_locked.wilson_lower_on_Neff_above: RR breakeven after the P2-measured cost

p5_metalabeling.features: only pre-existing causal features; NO new indicators; NO direction training

forbidden: reading any confirmation set more than once
